shortDefinition.en: Fujifilm's named in-camera rendering options for interpreting color and tone with different creative palettes.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 富士相机内已命名的呈现选项，用不同创意调色风格解释色彩与影调。

en: A Film Simulation is not a third-party recipe, a universal software LUT, or proof of an identical match to a named film stock.
zh-cn: 胶片模拟不是第三方配方、通用软件 LUT，也不证明与某款胶片完全一致。

example.en: On an X-T5, a Film Simulation can be combined with separate tone, sharpness, grain, and white-balance settings.
example.zh-cn: X-T5 上，胶片模拟可与独立的影调、锐度、颗粒和白平衡设置组合。

sources.title: IMAGE QUALITY SETTING (Still Photography) — FUJIFILM X-T5 Owner’s Manual
sources.supports: The camera's film-simulation palette and its combination with other rendering controls.
